body:
**Update, 5 November 2026: this PR now proposes C82 < 0.2519964890\*** (candidate, unrefereed). It replaces this PR's earlier rows: 0.252404806\*, which V. Patankar's PR #280 v3 (0.2520591386\*) had beaten, and this morning's 0.2520179248\*, an earlier checkpoint of the same search. The search has since ended after three rounds without gain, and this is its final certificate.

**Comparison with #280.** We replayed the public #280 certificates with our own interval verifier: v3 gives B in [0.2520591385259548 ± 1.94·10⁻¹⁷], and v4, posted at 13:30 UTC today, gives B in [0.25200797232842968 ± 9.19·10⁻¹⁸]. Both agree with #280's printed values (0.2520591386\* and 0.2520079724\*). The bound here is below both. It is built on #280 v3. According to #280, v4 uses no factor of this PR's earlier update; v4 uses none of the seven denominators newly found in this search, and the two certificates share only factors already in #280 v3 (the denominator D11_5_0 and nine numerators). No global priority or optimality claim is made.

**What is new and what is reused.** The certificate has eight monic degree-104 denominators. Seven are new in this search; two of those were already in this PR's previous version. The eighth, D11_5_0, is from the #280 v3 certificate. All 15 numerators are existing public factors: Doche's P1, P2, P3, P4 and P6, MS360 from our PR #301, and nine factors from #280 v3 or #280's public numerator bank. The search re-solved the joint LP of PR #301 (reduced costs, residue-class restriction) over the union of the #280 v3 factors and our earlier ones, then added denominators with our reimplementation of V. Patankar's weighted-evaluation closest-vector method and re-solved the exact rational weights. Doche is credited for the limit-point construction, Grinsztajn and Épi for earlier factor libraries and methods, as on the live page. The packet's [README](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/README.md) and [FACTOR_PROVENANCE.json](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/FACTOR_PROVENANCE.json) give the origin of every factor by full coefficient comparison.

No Python from vidigoat/optimization-records is included, imported or run in this packet; [PYTHON_BLOBS.json](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/PYTHON_BLOBS.json) compares every Python file against that repository's trees at 197962c and 3a7a84f (no matches). The coefficient data from that MIT-licensed repository are listed in the [third-party notice](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md).

**Verification.** D = 1,000,000,000,064, a = deg A/b = 58700834920208207/65536. The separately written interval verifier `verify_best.py` (standard library and python-flint only) checks integer coefficients, monic denominators, positive integer multiplicities, nonnegative rational exponents, the strict degree inequality and all 120 active numerator/denominator gcd pairs, isolates all 2126 composed roots with FLINT, and encloses B = H + J with Arb at 256 bits:

    0.2519964889882011564383 ≤ B ≤ 0.2519964889882011727026

The exact upper endpoint is below 0.2519964890 by about 1.18·10⁻¹¹. The fresh release run takes 37 seconds on one core ([receipt](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/receipts/release-verifier.json), [REPRODUCE.md](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/REPRODUCE.md)). The mathematical reduction is Doche's limit-point argument (C. Doche, [“Zhang-Zagier heights of perturbed polynomials”](https://www.numdam.org/item/JTNB_2001__13_1_103_0/), J. Théor. Nombres Bordeaux 13 (2001), 103–110), with the extraction step written out in the [proof](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/PROOF.md); it remains a mathematical argument requiring review.

**Referee.** A separate AI referee was given only a claim note, our earlier released proof text and this certificate, and was instructed to attack the claim. It checked the reduction against the live 82a definition and Doche's paper, checked every exact hypothesis, and wrote its own interval checker without reading or running our code. Verdict: **HOLDS WITH CAVEATS**. Its enclosure, B ∈ [0.251996488988201164531880087886, 0.251996488988201164532207712015], lies inside ours. The caveat is provenance: the receipt's model string is “GPT-6-based Codex (exact serving-model ID not exposed)”. According to the launcher record the referee ran on GPT-6 Astra, a different model from the search, but the receipt cannot establish that. This is an AI review, not a second human party. [Referee report](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/review/REFEREE.md), [replay receipt](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/REPLAY.json).

Packet: [c82/degree104-joint](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint) ([certificate](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/certificate.json), [verifier](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint/verify_best.py)).

**Verification level: L0** for the bound as a whole ([definitions](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/59eeb7097f806da05187b5f234445be3589204d4/VERIFICATION_LEVELS.md)). The search and verifier were written by the same AI agent lineage.

**Interaction with #280 and other open PRs.** The live merged page prints 0.2536331090204145 (0.2534449\*) as the upper entry. Open PRs changing 82a at this update: #242, #280 (0.2520079724\*) and #301 (0.253091834\*). The resulting PR is based on main 87b4ebbd and adds one row and one reference. If #280 or #301 merges first, keep their rows and references and append this one; in the README line, keep the lower entry and unasterisked upper value and replace only the parenthesized candidate with 0.2519964890\*. If #242 merges first, the README upper cell becomes 0.2534449 (0.2519964890\*). No claim is made that these PRs have merged.

Earlier packets for this PR: 0.252404806\* at [c82/degree104-cvp](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/5461d490552a518667c3fd3fceff33ebdb4d347c/c82/degree104-cvp), with its third-party notice, and 0.2520179248\* at [c82/degree104-joint (earlier checkpoint)](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/98208a40e043e578d35183b418452f316112a658/c82/degree104-joint).

AI use and author review: Analysis and proof drafting by AI agents under my direction; I reviewed the results at summary level. AI agents also prepared the certificate, verifiers and submission text. This does not claim a line-by-line human verification.

**Models:** GPT-6.1 Sol via Codex (search, certificate, verifier, packaging); GPT-6 Astra via Codex, per the launcher record (separate AI referee and replay); Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 (coordination and PR text).
